interpretation.description: one line: how the offering, regions and holdings were read, and which codes or terms were searched

quiet.description: true when no new tender was found: new_tenders is then empty

new_tenders.description: tenders not in the previous report, earliest deadline first

title.description: as published, with an English translation in brackets when needed

value.description: the stated figure with currency and tax basis, or the words not stated

deadline.description: date, time and zone as the notice gives them, or the words zone not stated, such as 2026-12-04 12:00 CET

eligibility_notes.description: set-asides, mandatory certifications, local presence rules, lots

notice_url.description: the notice page itself, never a search page or a portal home page

checked_on.description: the day this run read the notice page and saw it open

closing_soon.description: true when the deadline is within 7 days of run_date

still_open.description: tenders the previous report listed that this run found still open, one short line each

changed.description: an amendment or a moved deadline, when the notice shows one; null otherwise

closed_since.description: tenders from the previous report that are now closed, cancelled or awarded, one line each with the notice that says so

near_misses.description: open notices left out for value or partial fit, one line each

report_markdown.description: what a person reads: new tenders by deadline with buyer, value, fit and eligibility, those closing within 7 days first, a line for tenders still open, near misses, do next, and the coverage line
